title: engine.json
description: What one installed Archer engine version says about itself. The release writes the output of `Archer --describe` here unchanged; the hub reads only this file inside an installed version.

version.description: Version of this file's format. Readers reject versions they do not know.

engine.description: Engine version (semver). A build without a stamped version says 0.0.0-dev.

commit.description: Engine source commit this version was built from (full git hash). Absent when the build was not stamped.

host.description: Operating system and CPU this bundle runs on, e.g. macos-arm64.

schema.description: Project format versions this engine handles.

reads.description: Lowest and highest project schema versions it opens, inclusive (older ones are migrated on open).

writes.description: Project schema version it saves. Always the highest of `reads`.

editor.description: Path of the editor executable, relative to the installed version's folder, with forward slashes.

templates.description: Templates a new project can start from. Ids are unique.

name.description: Display name by locale (BCP 47 tag). English is required; other locales fall back to it.

dimension.description: Whether the template's world is 2D or 3D.

folder.description: Template project folder, relative to the installed version's folder.

picture.description: Preview image (PNG), relative to the installed version's folder.

toolchains.description: Script compilers shipped inside this version.

platform.description: Platform id: lowercase words joined by '-', e.g. macos-arm64, windows-x64, web.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes: no leading '/', no '\', no '.' or '..' segments.
